title: Deployment: the platform on AWS in us-east-1, one VPC across two availability zones (one drawn), each role of diagram 02 an ECS service with its own credentials, the managed stores beside it, fAuth and the model provider outside

nodes.label: DNS and certificates
nodes.desc: The platform name and the canary name; a health check fails the edge name over to the load balancer

nodes.label: CloudFront
nodes.desc: Caches hash-named assets only; nothing under /v1; forwards pages and API calls

nodes.label: fAuth
nodes.desc: Hosted sign-in; EdDSA tokens; key set fetched hourly and on an unknown kid

nodes.label: Model provider
nodes.desc: Reached only by the workers, through the NAT gateways' fixed addresses

nodes.label: Load balancer and WAF
nodes.desc: TLS; routes by host; 100 requests per client in 10 s; a weighted target group for the release wave

nodes.label: Workspace server
nodes.desc: One task per zone, each sized for the design point; database role workspace; the only role fAuth and members reach

nodes.label: Data service
nodes.tech: ECS service: 2 tasks, 4 vCPU, 16 GiB, 50 GiB disk
nodes.desc: One task per zone; 8 DuckDB instances of 1 GiB each; the revision cache on local disk; database role data

nodes.label: Composer and import workers
nodes.desc: Eight job slots; parsers as WebAssembly modules with no system interface; database role worker; the only role with egress

nodes.label: Control plane
nodes.desc: Admission, policy, publications, governance audit; database role control; off the published-app path

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.desc: Synchronous standby in the other zone; four database roles under row-level security; 7 days of point-in-time recovery

nodes.label: Secrets Manager
nodes.desc: The four database credentials, the provider key, fAuth's client secret; read by each task at start

nodes.label: Object storage
nodes.tech: S3, versioned, through a gateway endpoint
nodes.desc: A prefix per organization under its key; originals, Parquet, exports, index files; 30 days of noncurrent versions

nodes.label: Key management
nodes.tech: KMS, one data key per organization
nodes.desc: Envelope encryption of every object; disabling a key is the deletion path

nodes.label: CloudWatch
nodes.desc: Every task writes here; alarms gate the release waves and page the operator

edges.label: routes by host, the canary name to the new target group [HTTP in the VPC]
redirects sign-in, exchanges the code, fetches the key set [HTTPS, via NAT]
runs typed queries, submits record commands [HTTP, service token]
admits, publishes, sets policy [HTTP, service token]
reads and writes sessions, drafts, work, jobs [TLS, role workspace]
writes publications, policy, audit [TLS, role control]
writes records, receipts, outcomes [TLS, role data]
read originals, write Parquet and index files [HTTPS, SigV4]
send schemas and synthetic rows, receive proposals [HTTPS, via NAT]

boundaries.label: The platform VPC: private subnets in two availability zones, one drawn; NAT gateways with fixed addresses, one per zone
